title: A better view of what people are making
summary:
A new image feed and React audio hook arrived alongside Z-Image upscaling and a tidier path for community app submissions.

The Play page gained a Watch Feed with single-image and grid views. It shows completed images across models, with prompt and model labels, while model selection stays in the Play view. On smaller screens, the Model Monitor table now scrolls horizontally so its latency and error columns remain reachable.

`@pollinations/react` added `usePollinationsAudio` to build text-to-speech URLs from text, with optional voice, model, and seed settings. A follow-up added its TypeScript definition.

Z-Image work added 2× SPAN upscaling for larger images and pixel-count limits that preserve the requested aspect ratio. Its native and output budgets were subsequently adjusted, generation was set to nine inference steps, and `steps` was removed from the request schema. The default image model changed to `zimage`; requests for `flux` now resolve to it rather than a separate Flux model.

highlights.title: Watch images take shape
highlights.text: The Play page has a Watch Feed for completed community images, with single-image and grid views plus prompt and model labels. [Open the playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Text-to-speech for React
highlights.text: Use `usePollinationsAudio` to build a speech URL from text, with optional voice, model, and seed settings. The hook also has a TypeScript definition. [Explore the React SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Larger Z-Image output
highlights.text: Larger Z-Image requests can use 2× SPAN upscaling while preserving the requested aspect ratio. `zimage` is now the default image model, and `flux` requests resolve to it. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
